claim: Jeffrey Epstein's own iMessages in the House Oversight estate release show him dealing with cosmetics heir and World Jewish Congress president Ronald Lauder in February 2017. On Feb. 22, 2017 Epstein writes that he is "meeting with lauder re alzheimer on friday, also with jim watson" — Lauder is a major Alzheimer's-research funder and "jim watson" is Nobel laureate James Watson, who had his own Epstein ties; days earlier Epstein writes "I sent bill a note to suggest he talk to lauder." Outside reporting on the same DOJ release identifies the figure as Ronald Lauder, names him across hundreds of documents with contact continuing to 2017, and details a Friends Ventures LLC art arrangement with Epstein and Apollo's Leon Black. Lauder is not accused of any wrongdoing in connection with Epstein.
